Episode: Mega Evolution |seo= }} (Japanese: '''メガボルテージ''' ''Mega Voltage'') is the fifth arc of {{aniseries|HZ}} that began airing on April 11, 2025 and concluded on September 19, 2025. The arc is set one year after the battle at [[Laqua]] and focuses on the grown-up versions of [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and [[Dot]]. The arc introduces [[Ult]], a new companion with his {{p|Sableye}}, and features [[Mega Evolution]] as a central element, including Roy's {{Shiny}} {{TP|Roy|Lucario}} and Ult's {{p|Sableye}}. The arc began with a one-hour special on April 11, 2025, and airs on [[TV Tokyo]]. The story follows the characters as they investigate mysterious Pokémon behavior linked to [[Laquium]] and embark on a journey to "retrieve something important." The arc's opening theme is [[GET BACK]] performed by {{wp|Yuzu (band)|Yuzu}}, and the ending theme is [[Ready Go]] performed by {{wp|ME:I}}. {{spoilers}} ==Plot== {{incomplete|section|needs=Synopsis of entire arc needed}} The arc takes place one year after the events at Laqua, with [[Liko]] attending [[Indigo Academy]] while [[Roy]] continues his adventures with [[Captain Pikachu]]. When Roy discovers information about Pokémon exhibiting abnormal behavior, he begins investigating, while being followed by [[Ult]] and his {{p|Sableye}}. The investigation reveals that Laquium, which was supposedly eliminated, is causing Pokémon to go berserk, including a {{p|Slaking}} that Roy and Ult witness in the forest. The arc also features the aftermath of the [[Explorers]] and the [[Six Heroes]], as Liko and Roy reunite for a new adventure alongside [[Dot]] and their new companion Ult. ==Gallery== ===Promotional material=== Pokémon Horizons Promotional Poster 7.jpg|First Key Visual Pokémon Horizons Promotional Poster 8.jpg|Second Key Visual ===Characters=== ;Main characters Liko anime 12.png|[[Liko]] Roy anime 10.png|[[Roy]] ;Supporting characters Dot anime 11.png|[[Dot]] Franka.png|[[Franka]] Ann School Uniform 2.png|[[Ann]] Mollie anime 2.png|[[Mollie]] Mollie Mom.png|[[Mollie's mother]] Murdock anime 2.png|[[Murdock]] Orla anime 2.png|[[Orla]] Ludlow anime 2.png|[[Ludlow]] Nemona HZ.png|{{an|Nemona}} Penny anime.png|[[Penny]] Amethio anime 6.png|[[Amethio]] Diana HZ.png|[[Diana]] Briar anime.png|[[Briar]] ;New characters Ult anime.png|[[Ult]] Snake.png|[[Snake]] Team Dragon Rampage.png|[[Team Dragon Rampage]] Stunner Fisk.png|[[Stunner Fisk]] Cabbie anime.png|{{tc|Cabbie}} Indi anime.png|[[Indi]] Rubina anime.png|[[Rubina]] Pepper.png|{{OBP|Pepper|HZ102}} Sand Surfer.png|[[Sand Surfer]] Ryan.png|{{OBP|Ryan|HZ106}} Manager HZ109.png|{{OBP|Manager|HZ109}} ;Others Spinel anime 2.png|[[Spinel]] Hamber HZ.png|[[Hamber]] Onia anime.png|[[Onia]] Zirc anime.png|[[Zirc]] Litten Smitten.png|[[Litten Smitten]] Coral anime 2.png|[[Coral]] Sidian anime 2.png|[[Sidian]] Chalce anime 2.png|[[Chalce]] Dash.png|[[Dash]] Iono HZ.png|{{an|Iono}} Katy HZ.png|[[Katy]] Karna.png|[[Karna]] Geeta HZ.png|[[Geeta]] Clavell anime.png|[[Clavell]] Jacq anime.png|[[Jacq]] Dendra anime.png|[[Dendra]] Grusha anime.png|[[Grusha]] Cervantis.png|[[Cervantis]] ===Pokémon debuts=== Ult Sableye.png|Ult's {{p|Sableye}} Roy Mega Lucario.png|[[Roy's Lucario|Roy's Mega Lucario]] ({{shiny}}) Ult Mega Sableye.png|Ult's {{me|Sableye}} Murdock Lycanroc.png|[[Murdock's Lycanroc]] Blaze Aqua Breed Paldean Tauros anime.png|{{p|Tauros}} ({{form|Paldean Tauros|Paldean Form;
